svg.title: Personal Agents OS: from data to the Life App
svg.desc: Agents write one JSON file per life area in data/happiness/. publish.sh validates, injects, builds and encrypts the app, regenerates the recaps and pushes only ciphertext to a separate Pages repo. The phone or desktop decrypts it with the password. Optional write-back saves small event files to a private repo that an agent folds into data/.
svg.text: PERSONAL AGENTS OS · 4 / 4 · THE LIFE APP
From data/ to an encrypted app
One file per area, one owner per file. The published site holds only ciphertext; the password opens it in the browser.
The build also reads markdown, when present:
An agent writes only its own file, only facts it has a source for.
the area data goes into the app page
esbuild bundles ONE file, encrypted whole: AES-256-GCM,
regenerates the .md recaps next to the JSON
one commit to your separate GitHub Pages repo
a wrong password is refused; every tab and area opens
Life Health: one score over seven areas
a static site that holds only ciphertext
the password decrypts it in the browser
without the password, the site is noise
Password and salt never go into git.
a tap (a pill taken, a weigh-in) → an event file in your private repo → an agent folds it into data/
Ships with fake sample data (every value says "sample"); setup.sh copies it into data/happiness/ until agents write real values.
